question: Which of following gases are found in coal mines and marshy places?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Methane**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Methane** is commonly found in coal mines and marshy places.
 
• It is a colorless, odorless gas that is highly flammable and can form explosive mixtures with air.
 
• Methane is produced by the anaerobic decomposition of organic matter.
